text:
elaine_prod: flagging a contentious item for the dedicated roadmap: how do reserve "credits" expire or carry over between billing windows? customers want predictability; finance wants clean cutoffs.
matt_eng: quick recap of current behavior: burst credits are granted per-cycle, unused credits drop at window end. no carryover. that causes customers to panic at EOW if they see unused value.
ravi_ops: operational problem: last month we had multiple support tickets where tenants burst in last 30m of period and then saw sudden throttles; they assumed unused credits would protect them next period.
sophie_sales: sales asks: 1) an option for limited carryover for enterprise customers, 2) a "credit-safety" mode to reserve N% of credits during last 2 hours to avoid surprise throttles for critical campaigns.
julia_legal: contract stuff: any carryover changes effective date + clear T&Cs. can't advertise "unlimited carryover" without billing guardrails.
matt_eng: technical tradeoffs:
- allow carryover (e.g., up to 20% carryover cap): requires ledger changes and sliding-window accounting.
- add safety-reserve during last-window: runtime-only, easier to ship.
- declassification: convert burst credits to "soft credits" after rollover that can be reclaimed under preemption (new state machine).
elaine_prod: proposal: two features:
1) safety-reserve: runtime flag, default off, keeps X credits aside for last Y minutes. low-risk.
2) soft-carryover: opt-in paid feature for enterprise: up to Z% credits carried as reclaimable soft-credits.
matt_eng: soft-carryover impl note: represent soft-credits as separate ledger entries with reclaimable tag. runtime must prefer hard credits first, soft credits next, and evict soft credits during contention with priority rules.
ravi_ops: runbook consequences: when reclaiming soft-credits we must surface a short notice in the console and optionally email customers. include automated throttling ramp-down to avoid sudden failures.
sophie_sales: pricing idea: carryover add-on = monthly fee + small premium per-byte of carried credits. safety-reserve can be free for pilot customers.
julia_legal: we need a contract amendment template and sample SLA language for soft-carry: "Soft-carry credits are opportunistic and may be reclaimed with 10m notice for capacity." Legal wants 10m minimum notice baked in.
matt_eng: sample config snippet:
```
credit_policy:
  safety_reserve:
    enabled: true
    reserve_pct: 10
    window_before_cutoff: 1200  # seconds
  soft_carry:
    enabled: false
    carry_pct_cap: 20
    reclaim_notice_secs: 600
```
deploy-bot: note: ledger migration required for soft-carry entries. scheduled maintenance window suggested.
elaine_prod: launch plan suggestion:
- phase 1: ship safety-reserve runtime flag + canary (no billing/ledger changes)
- phase 2: soft-carry pilot with 3 enterprise customers + billing ledger update + legal amendment
- phase 3: GA with docs + sales playbook
sophie_sales: pilot acceptance criteria:
- no more than 2 customer incidents related to unexpected throttles in pilot window
- customer satisfaction >= 8/10 on post-pilot survey
- reclaim events logged and consumer visible in console
ravi_ops: ops acceptance: automated reclaim ramp-down must not cause >10% increased error rate for downstream tenant traffic. set synthetic tests.
matt_eng: timeline estimate: safety-reserve = 1 sprint, soft-carry ledger + runtime = 3-4 sprints (depends on ledger complexity).
julia_legal: lead time for amendments: 2 weeks for template + 1 week for sign-off for pilot customers.
elaine_prod: owners: matt=eng, ravi=ops, sophie=sales, julia=legal. I'll own product comms and pilot coordination.
elaine_prod: decisions: proceed with safety-reserve canary immediately. start legal + billing workstreams for soft-carry pilot in parallel. document stored in product tracker.
matt_eng: will open PR for safety-reserve flag and add canary harness. will post rollout steps tomorrow.
ravi_ops: will create canary alerting and synthetic test jobs.
sophie_sales: I'll line up 3 enterprise pilots and prep survey.
elaine_prod: thanks team. we'll reconvene after canary results and ledger design doc. :shipit:
